info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Routing Decisions API
info.description: The Routing Decisions API facilitates the determination of optimal routing for market data operations. Designed for financial institutions, this API allows users to submit complex market data switch operations and receive tailored routing decisions. Typical consumers include trading platforms and financial analysts who rely on precise market data management. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their trading efficiency and improve market responsiveness.

post.summary: Create a new routing decision for market data.
post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create a new routing decision within the context of market data operations. The routing decision will be utilized to determine how market data will be processed and handled, ensuring streamlined operations and improved decision-making.
